scripts.android:sync: npm run build:mobile && cap sync android && node scripts/prepare-android.mjs
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
